name: netbootxyz
title: Netboot.xyz
description: Self-hosted PXE/netboot server — boot OS installers, live distros, and utilities over the network from an iPXE menu. Serves TFTP boot files and mirrors assets locally. Pairs with airpxe for Wi-Fi netboot: hosted menu.txt and logo.png are served from the assets volume over HTTP.

variables.name: PORT_NETBOOTXYZ_UI
variables.label: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port for the netboot.xyz menu editor web interface

variables.name: PORT_NETBOOTXYZ_HTTP
variables.label: Assets HTTP Port
variables.description: Port serving local boot assets and hosted menu.txt for airpxe

variables.name: PORT_NETBOOTXYZ_TFTP
variables.label: TFTP Port
variables.description: UDP port for PXE boot file delivery
